name: computer_drag
description: Press the mouse button at one coordinate, drag to another, and release. Or pass path (2–64 points) to drag through them in order in one call (a whole outline); a path of over two points must stay inside the window it starts in.

path.description: {x, y} points, in order; replaces from and to.

zoom_id.description: Id from a computer_zoom result: the points are then pixels of that zoom image.
